Type.evidence_source: [page/5/Text/8] All the participants described how their self-identity was broken and their self-esteem and self-image shattered. Henry experienced himself as a loser because of the suicidal thoughts and he began to tear himself down for thinking like that, which increased even more his inner suffering. Negative thoughts and hopelessness went hand in hand with a broken self-image as well as much selfdegradation which was characteristic of the participants. Area.evidence_source: [page/5/Text/8] All the participants described how their self-identity was broken and their self-esteem and self-image shattered. Henry experienced himself as a loser because of the suicidal thoughts and he began to tear himself down for thinking like that, which increased even more his inner suffering. Negative thoughts and hopelessness went hand in hand with a broken self-image as well as much selfdegradation which was characteristic of the participants. Participants talked about how they experienced themselves as dreadful people. Kevin said he did not remember attempting suicide, but there was much thought about it. He degraded himself on the smallest occasion and explained: [page/5/Text/9] I just did not care about myself and I was always degrading myself: I was so lousy and terrible, and it would be best for these people to just get rid of me [...] I just went into some capsule and was just completely frozen. I felt the most pathetic, disgusting man in the world.
